title: BRENT TradingView signal feed decoupled from broker quote, gap widening
detail: Signal price/level/extreme track a real-world Brent spike (US-Iran/Hormuz, CPC terminal attacks) that this DEMO broker's feed does not reflect. tick81: signal 93.815-95.994 vs broker 90.635-92.099 (~3.8-4.4pt / ~4.2-4.5% gap). tick95: signal 95.743-98.707 vs broker 90.635-93.88 (~4.7-4.9pt / ~5.0-5.2%). Gap is DIVERGING, not converging. Confirmed across 3 BRENT signals on 23 Jul (08:46, 09:30, 10:00). get_symbols confirms only one BRENT symbol, so this is not a wrong-contract mapping error.
impact: Signal level/extreme cannot be used to build a structural SL/TP that would fill on this broker. Every BRENT signal costs a full Tier2 session to reach NO_ACTION.
classification: NOT learn-mode-downgradable (data-trust, not a discretionary gate)
recommendation: Evan to verify which exchange/vendor the TradingView BRENT alert is sourced from and re-point or disable it until it matches the broker. Until reconciled, treat BRENT signal price fields as advisory-only and use broker-native H1/H4 for structure.

title: WTI shows the same feed decoupling as BRENT - now systemic to oil
detail: First WTI signal since instrument_policy was emptied 23 Jul. Broker bid/ask 88.948/88.963, session range 86.534-89.353; 48h of H1 history confirms the broker has never traded above 89.353. Signal price 91.293 and level 90.803 sit ~1.5-2.3pt (~1.7-2.6%) above the entire broker-visible range. Same pattern as FLAG-001.
impact: Second oil instrument affected. Indicates a feed-pairing issue across oil symbols during the Iran/Hormuz spike rather than a BRENT-specific fault. Independent broker-native check also found no M15 trigger, so NO_ACTION was correct on two grounds.
classification: NOT learn-mode-downgradable (data-trust, not a discretionary gate)
recommendation: Treat all WTI and BRENT TradingView signal price/level/extreme fields as advisory-only; build structure from broker-native H1/H4 only, until the vendor feeds reconcile. Same alert-source check as FLAG-001.

title: MCP silently reverts active account to 41750592; stray positions accumulating there
detail: Every new MCP connection reports previous=41750592 before switch_trading_account is called. Warning count on 41750592 observed rising from 1 open position (22 Jul) to 2 (23 Jul). All ticks have correctly switched and verified before ordering, and USDJPY/EURJPY both confirmed on 41829612.
impact: Known critical bug. Ticks are handling it correctly via the 5-step routing procedure, but positions on the wrong account are unmanaged by this system.
classification: infrastructure - mitigated in-process, residue not cleaned
recommendation: Evan to inspect and close/reconcile the 2 stray positions on 41750592 manually.
